856-4247-4321-8347.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-4247-4321-8347.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Sela trigger.
Resolve the Sela trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

2034-4681-5170-8292.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Massacre Girl triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Massacre Girl trigger.
Resolve the Massacre Girl trigger, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

141-802.easyPrerequisites: There is a creature on the battlefield.
141-802.notablePrerequisites: You control two lands that collectively tap for enough to cast Naru Meha.
141-802.description:
Cast Snap by paying {1}{U}, targeting any creature.
With the original Snap on the stack, cast Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha ETB, causing you to create a copy of Snap and change its target to Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Snap, returning Naru Meha to your hand and untapping two lands that produce enough to recast it.
Repeat from step 2.
141-802.notes: If your chosen lands tap for more than {2}{U}{U}, this combo results in infinite mana.

116-3469-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Energy Arc is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Kiora's Follower doesn't have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
116-3469-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Energy Arc without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Energy Arc, untapping all creatures you control
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

529-1322-7690-8181--165.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-7296-8139.easyPrerequisites: Scepter of Celebration is attached to a creature you control other than the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
3259-7296-8139.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7296-8139.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and the creature that has Scepter of Celebration attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Scepter of Celebration.
Resolve the Scepter of Celebration trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

222-527-4927-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4927-8095.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Hammerhead twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1286-4247-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
1286-4247-5972.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

5078-7356-7902.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Longshot.
Longshot triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Fateful Discovery triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Fateful Discovery trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat

4377-5144-7874.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking The Immortal Weapons and exiling Ephemerate.
When The Immortal Weapons enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking The Immortal Weapons.
When The Immortal Weapons enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is paired with Patron of the Arts

1409-1652-7824.description:
Activate Patron of the Arts by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Patron of the Arts enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Patron of the Arts.
Resolve the Patron of the Arts trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

997-1003-2626-4986.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
Activate Salvager of Ruin by sacrificing it, returning Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Salvager of Ruin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2292-2946-4871-4976.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2292-2946-4871-4976.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Open the Graves trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

413-1263-4556-4871.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Blight Mound and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodsoaked Champion enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Repeat.

186-2060-5140-7741.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
186-2060-5140-7741.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

511-817-4050-6705-7704.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

3259-6968-7659.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6968-7659.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Brimaz as attackers.
Brimaz triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

997-3215-6871-6879.description:
Cast Bloodline Pretender by paying {3}.
When Bloodline Pretender enters, Haru triggers, targeting Bloodline Pretender as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Bloodline Pretender.
When Bloodline Pretender dies, Haru triggers, returning Bloodline Pretender from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Bloodline Pretender enters, Haru triggers, targeting Bloodline Pretender as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1652-5626-7056.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least {E}{E}{E}.
You have a creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
1652-5626-7056.description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Patron of the Arts and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Patron of the Arts dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing another creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Patron of the Arts from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Patron of the Arts enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

339-677-1115-5256.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4508-5880-5929-6291.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

511-817-3334-4050-6705.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Frog and a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Frog and Saproling, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

1238-2351-5467-5929-6798.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

2416-4222-6788.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand with the mana to cast it, including at least one colored mana.
2416-4222-6788.description:
Animate Solar Array, if needed.
Cast Freed from the Real by paying its mana cost, attaching it to Solar Array.
Activate Solar Array by tapping it, adding {U} and causing the next artifact spell you cast this turn to have sunburst.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Solar Array.
Repeat from step 3 as desired.
Cast any artifact spell, triggering its sunburst ability an infinite number of times, either putting infinite +1/+1 counters on charge counters on the artifact.
2416-4222-6788.notes: This combo can be repeated whenever you want to cast an artifact spell. If needed as well, you can tap Solar Array for colored mana to use in casting that spell, assuming you do not want to continue the combo after the spell is cast.

222-2034-2060-6701.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
Szarel has power 3 or greater or you have another creature card in your graveyard.
222-2034-2060-6701.description:
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and up to one other creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee, and the other creature returned in step 1, if applicable, adding {C}{C} for each creature sacrificed.
When Slimefoot and Squee and up to one other creature are sacrificed, Szarel triggers that many times, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler for each trigger.
Activate Crystalline Crawler three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {B}{R}{G}.
Repeat.
222-2034-2060-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

5720-5721-6620-6664.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
Lands you control and/or land cards in your graveyard that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
5720-5721-6620-6664.description:
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

997-2425-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
997-2425-6249--5.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Smothering Abomination trigger.
Resolve the Smothering Abomination trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

413-618-6473.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Mardu Siegebreaker.
When the Mardu Siegebreaker token enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Mardu Siegebreaker trigger, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Mardu Siegebreaker token.
When the Mardu Siegebreaker token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Kiki-Jiki enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat.

2457-2557-5794-6441.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

2523-5256-5401.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Bilbo.
When Bilbo dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Bilbo that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Bilbo token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Bilbo token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

997-1049-2440-4871.manaNeeded: {1}{R}{W}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable, or an additional {R}, {W} or {B} if you haven't cast Jirina from the command zone this game
997-1049-2440-4871.description:
Cast Jirina from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{W}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Jirina enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Jirina trigger, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token for each time you've cast Jirina from the command zone this game.
When the Human Soldiers enter the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Human and Soldier you control.
Repeat step 5 for each remaining Mana Echoes trigger created in steps 2 and 4.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing Jirina and a Human Soldier.
Choose to return Jirina to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Jirina and the Human Soldier die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Holding priority, if you control a Human Soldier, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a Human Soldier.
If you sacrificed a Human Soldier this way, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider abilities from steps 7 and 10, causing you to scry 1 three times.
Activate up to three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding any combination of {R}, {W} and {B}.
Repeat.

779-1594-4970-5751.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding Dakmor Salvage.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1770-3484-3921-5391.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
1770-3484-3921-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a tapped 3/3 Robot artifact creature token.
When the Robot enters the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

457-1247-3099.description:
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Pili-Pala, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate either Urza or Leyline of Abundance's abilities.

575-1968-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Scornful Egotist, adding {U}.
When Scornful Egotist dies, Yedora triggers, returning Scornful Egotist from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Scornful Egotist by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Scornful Egotist's morph ability by paying {U}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

1563-1867-2206-4365-5270.description:
Cast Gingerbrute by paying {1}.
When Gingerbrute enters the battlefield, Samwise triggers, creating two Food tokens.
Activate the two Foods by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing Gingerbrute and the two Foods, returning Vegetation Abomination from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Vegetation Abomination by paying {2}{G}.
When Vegetation Abomination enters the battlefield, Samwise triggers, creating two Food tokens.
Activate the two Food tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing Vegetation Abomination and the two Foods, returning Gingerbrute from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1242-1656-4017-5162.notablePrerequisites:
Sunbond attached to Necrotic Ooze.
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
1242-1656-4017-5162.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Kwain's ability by tapping it, allowing each player to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Necrotic Ooze triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

628-3108-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Grim Poppet.
When Grim Poppet dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.
628-3108-4050.notes: You can remove the additional -1/-1 counters from Grim Poppet and put them on other creatures as desired.

2471-2834-4659-4763.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Zabaz, adding {C}{C}.
Zabaz dies, triggering its modular ability and Koll.
Resolve the Zabaz trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on any artifact creature you control.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning Zabaz from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Zabaz by paying {1}.
Zabaz enters the battlefield, triggering Hero's Blade, attaching Hero's Blade to Zabaz.
Repeat.
